name: sheaim_mage
description: a Sheaim Mage (Fall from Heaven), a pale lavender-skinned sorcerer: a tall pointed deep-purple hood, a purple robe with gold trim, gold shoulder plates and a gold rune border at the hem, a red sash knotted at the waist, brown boots, a glowing magenta swirl orb floating above his raised RIGHT hand, and a spiked black staff topped with a glowing pink swirl orb in his LEFT hand
hands: the orb-topped spiked staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is raised palm-up with a magenta orb floating above it

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the orb-topped staff thrown up and out to the right in his left hand, his right hand flung out to the left with the magenta orb wobbling above it), the tall purple hood jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the orb-topped staff dipping, his right hand still held out under the floating magenta orb

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the orb-topped staff high, his right hand drooping and the magenta orb above it flickering
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the orb-topped staff lowering, the floating magenta orb fading away
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the orb end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-left, his empty right hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the orb-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the purple robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the tall hood crumpled under his head; the orb-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-left; the robe with its gold border spread around his legs
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the purple robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the orb-topped staff on the ground beside him, its pink orb dimmed
